launched_6mo.notes: On September 23, 2026, Sitetracker announced portfolio-scale digital twins and asset intelligence through an integration of 5×5 Synthetic Twin technology, a major new platform capability within the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage offers a live-demo call to action and does not show a public pricing page or pricing link.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 440 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists a “Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Middle East)” position.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public Scout page, AI product terms and available legal/security information; they refer to AI and third-party model providers generically but do not identify a provider used by the product.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear among Sitetracker customer stories.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists an “AI Developer - Salesforce Admin” role.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal page links to an EU and UK GDPR Compliance document. No other requested certification was substantiated from the reviewed page.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page explicitly names Salesforce among supported platform integrations.

product_one_liner.notes: The site describes a platform for critical-infrastructure asset owners and operators across areas such as digital infrastructure, energy transition, and utilities.
product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker is an asset-lifecycle management platform that helps owners, operators, contractors, and other organizations plan, build, operate, and maintain critical infrastructure.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available company people page is not a leadership roster, and no verifiable dated C-level or VP-level join or departure in the 12-month window was found.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index primarily presents industry guidance, customer/product marketing, and thought leadership; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

claygent-auto-A.reasoning: Core company details were supported by the official website and LinkedIn profile; customer names, funding, product launch, integrations, and current openings were verified against relevant company pages or the live job board.
